facts: Amanda Williams is listed as Owner & Director and Registered Dental Assistant.
The academy says Amanda graduated from its program, worked chairside in East Texas, bought the school, and teaches and mentors in Longview.
Practice Pro is a training environment covering dental-office scheduling, charting, treatment plans, insurance workflows, notes, and recall.
The public Virtual Dental Office includes operatory stations, guided visits, and instrument-tray practice.
The tour page accepts in-person or virtual walkthrough requests and routes them to Amanda or her team.
